blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The Department of Agriculture (DA) gathered swine industry stakeholders in Ilocos Norte and Ilocos Sur to discuss declining farmgate prices of liveweight hogs and measures to strengthen the local livestock industry. The FY 2026 Swine Stakeholders’ Forum, themed “Nurturing Livestock for Prosperity,” was held on Nov. 19 at Paoay Lake
